rv.q: Loesser's score is breathtaking, and North Coast Rep has assembled a company capable of delivering every note with passion, precision, humor, and heart.
Under the superb direction of Jeffrey B. Moss, the rock-solid cast soars with commanding voices, dynamic duets and harmonies you'll wish would never end.
"The Most Happy Fella" may be an old story, but Moss has done a very good job giving it a fresh shine.
